Cart Total Ignores Quantity - 2x $79.00 Still Shows $79.00 Total
Fixed and verified

Fixed and verified. Two Aurora headphones now add up to $158.00 in the cart.

Run e0f7314310 · 2026-10-31 00:36 · repo artifacts/tmp/repro_e2e/shop · app http://127.0.0.1:60391 · branch nimbus/repro-68303b9d22 @ addec75f7a

The report

Cart line quantity/line-total updates but Subtotal/Total do not recalculate with quantity

Expected
After adding 2 x Aurora Headphones @ $79.00 each, cart should show Qty 2, Line Total $158.00, Subtotal $158.00, Total $158.00. Discount $0.00.
Actual
After 2nd click cart line correctly updates to `Aurora Headphones Qty 2 x $79.00 = $158.00` but `Subtotal` remains `$79.00` and `Total` remains `$79.00` with `Discount -$0.00`. Total/subtotal ignore quantity. Bug visible from ~00:10-00:11 after 2nd `Add to cart` and persists to end of video.

Root cause
`subtotal()` in cart.js summed `line.priceCents` without multiplying by `line.quantity`, unlike `lineTotal()`.
Change
Changed `subtotal()` to sum `lineTotal(line)` so quantity is included.
